evidence.description: Direct access to the EcosiaAuthUIStateProvider singleton service via .shared.

candidates.explanation: The component directly accesses an operational service through a .shared singleton property instead of receiving it through an explicit dependency injection mechanism.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: Force unwrapping of the result of Calendar.current.date(byAdding:value:to:) without a visible guarantee that the date calculation will succeed.

candidates.explanation: The code uses a force unwrap (!) on a date calculation result where a failure (returning nil) is possible, without providing a visible guarantee or safe handling mechanism.
candidates.title: Unjustified Force Unwrapping
